divisions.title: The Epistle
divisions.theme: Growing in grace and guarding against false teaching
divisions.summary: Add to faith virtue, knowledge, and love; beware of false teachers who exploit; the day of the Lord will come suddenly

chapterSummaries.1: God's divine power gives us everything for life and godliness, make your calling sure
chapterSummaries.2: False teachers condemned, judgment awaits them as it did fallen angels and Sodom
chapterSummaries.3: The day of the Lord will come, new heavens and new earth where righteousness dwells
